name: WF-450 — Portfolio Performance Intelligence → Source ROI, Deal Profitability & Growth Action Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const portfolioId=String(b.portfolioId??'').trim(); const period=String(b.period??'').trim(); const asOfDate=String(b.asOfDate??new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)).trim(); return [{json:{...b,portfolioId,period,asOfDate,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Portfolio Performance Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const deals=Array.isArray(ctx.closedDeals)?ctx.closedDeals:[]; const sources=Array.isArray(ctx.sourcePerformance)?ctx.sourcePerformance:[]; const flags=[]; if(!deals.length)flags.push('no_closed_deals'); const n=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):0; const totalGross=deals.reduce((s,d)=>s+n(d.grossRevenue??d.assignmentFee),0); const totalNet=deals.reduce((s,d)=>s+n(d.netProfit),0); const totalSpend=deals.reduce((s,d)=>s+n(d.sourceSpend??d.spend),0); const profitable=deals.filter(d=>n(d.netProfit)>0).length; const lossDeals=deals.filter(d=>n(d.netProfit)<0).length; const avgProfit=deals.length?Math.round(totalNet/deals.length*100)/100:0; const portfolioROI=totalSpend>0?Math.round(totalNet/totalSpend*10000)/100:0; const dealRankings=deals.map(d=>({dealId:d.dealId,netProfit:n(d.netProfit),grossRevenue:n(d.grossRevenue??d.assignmentFee),source:String(d.source??'unknown'),channel:String(d.channel??'unknown'),campaign:String(d.campaign??'unknown')})).sort((a,b)=>b.netProfit-a.netProfit); const topDeals=dealRankings.slice(0,5); const sourceIntelligence=sources.map(s=>{const spend=n(s.spend??s.sourceSpend); const net=n(s.netProfit); const closed=n(s.closedDeals); const leads=n(s.leads); const roi=spend>0?Math.round(net/spend*10000)/100:null; const profitPerLead=leads>0?Math.round(net/leads*100)/100:null; const profitPerClosed=closed>0?Math.round(net/closed*100)/100:null; const closeRate=leads>0?Math.round(closed/leads*10000)/100:null; let action='collect_more_data'; if(spend>0&&roi>=100&&closeRate!==null&&closeRate>=2&&net>0)action='scale_or_expand'; else if(spend>0&&roi>=0&&net>=0)action='maintain_and_optimize'; else if(spend>0&&net<0)action='reduce_or_pause'; return {...s,roi,profitPerLead,profitPerClosed,closeRate,recommendedAction:action};}).sort((a,b)=>n(b.netProfit)-n(a.netProfit)); const growthActions=[]; if(totalNet>0)growthActions.push('protect_profitable_sources_and_reinvest_based_on_verified_roi'); if(sourceIntelligence.some(s=>s.recommendedAction==='scale_or_expand'))growthActions.push('increase_budget_for_high_confidence_profitable_sources'); if(sourceIntelligence.some(s=>s.recommendedAction==='reduce_or_pause'))growthActions.push('reduce_or_pause_negative_profit_sources'); if(avgProfit>0)growthActions.push('improve_deal_volume_without_lowering_underwriting_standards'); if(!growthActions.length)growthActions.push('collect_more_performance_data_before_scaling'); const performanceState=deals.length===0?'insufficient_data':totalNet>0?'profitable_portfolio':'profitability_recovery_needed'; const decision=performanceState==='profitable_portfolio'?'optimize_and_scale_selectively':performanceState==='profitability_recovery_needed'?'protect_cash_and_reprice_acquisition':'collect_more_data'; const idempotencyKey='wf450:'+input.portfolioId+':'+input.period+':'+input.asOfDate; return [{json:{...input,portfolioPerformanceIntelligence:{status:performanceState,decision,closedDealCount:deals.length,totalGrossRevenue:Math.round(totalGross*100)/100,totalNetProfit:Math.round(totalNet*100)/100,totalSourceSpend:Math.round(totalSpend*100)/100,profitableDeals:profitable,lossDeals,averageNetProfit:avgProfit,portfolioROI,topProfitableDeals:topDeals,sourceIntelligence,growthActions,flags,requiresHumanReview:flags.length>0,confidenceScore:deals.length>=10?95:deals.length>=3?80:45},idempotencyKey}}];

meta.notes: Aggregates verified closed-deal performance, source ROI and profitability and produces selective growth actions. Production use requires canonical closed-deal accounting definitions, validated source-spend attribution, portfolio analytics schema and production InsulaCRM API contracts.
